title: CDS Geography
summary: CDS Geography past questions, CDS 2 2016 to CDS 2 2026, five a day. Questions UPSC asked again and the question types it keeps asking come first, ranked together by how often they were asked, then every other question.
note: Repeats are counted across the 21 papers, CDS 2 2016 to CDS 2 2026. UPSC reuses facts more than wording, so a repeat is the same fact asked again, often in a new form. Groups were found by a chapter-by-chapter reading (scripts/homework/REVIEW_BRIEF_CDS_GAT.md) and checked in the main session.
